title: Digital-arrest call (Hindi), recorded
description: An AI scammer (a Gemini script-writer reacting to the decoy's actual words, voiced by Gemini text-to-speech, all fictional) phones the live decoy. Everything on the right, from the transcript to the confirmed UPI ID and bank account, was produced by the real pipeline during this call. Both voices are exactly what each side produced; the pauses between turns are shortened, and the measured reply delay is in the stats. The spoken Hindi is shown as an English transcript.

steps: Impersonate a senior CBI officer and allege that an illegal parcel containing drugs and fake passports was seized in the victim's name.
Claim an arrest warrant has been issued and order the victim to stay on the line without telling anyone.
Demand a refundable security deposit to clear the victim's name and avoid immediate arrest.
Provide bank and UPI details under a private company name, insisting it is an authorized government account.
Issue a strict 30-minute deadline and threaten physical arrest at the victim's residence if money is not sent immediately.
redFlags: Caller claims to be a CBI officer and threatens arrest over a mysterious parcel.
Demands urgent payment of money to prove innocence or cancel a warrant.
Asks to transfer money to a private business account under the guise of an official deposit.
